summary: Eva Live Inc. filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026, disclosing a Forbearance Agreement with Streeterville Capital, LLC, settling a dispute over a claimed Major Trigger Event tied to the Company's October 2, 2026 Dune Equity Holdings financing. The Lender permanently waived the Restricted Issuance Trigger and consented to future Dune issuances. The Company ratified the notes, acknowledging aggregate outstanding balances of $7,919,203.94 ($5,637,774.51 February Note; $2,281,429.43 July Note). Conversion and redemption rights remain intact. Watch for future Trigger Events that would terminate forbearance and re-expose the Company to default remedies.
